source.title: Source context for nine coastal and reversing-flow reference extents

documents.title: Schott and McCreary2001, selected retained original text

sensitivity_interpretation: Route-specific endpoint/drawing sensitivity. Coastal entries can declare smaller or one-sided offshore offsets. These are not physical confidence limits or annual variation; all cases retained.
dateline_policy: Shortest geodesics; continuous display unwrapping and periodic coarse land copies.

records.source_locator: Chapter16 printed287-288 / PDF297-298, Figure16.18: usual penetration about27N, retracted path after shedding about25N; version December2001.
records.scope: Yucatan Strait entrance to western Florida Strait handoff using a declared extended Loop phase. Detached rings, Caribbean upstream and Florida Current downstream are excluded.
records.source_time_convention: Representative extended-loop convention; source Figure16.18 combines 1980-1984 mean and shedding states. No annual extrema or fixed seasonal phase inferred.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

records.source_locator: Chapter8 printed127-129 / PDF137-139, Figure8.23; version March2005. Australia to northern New Zealand near34S; strongly meandering and sometimes no identifiable continuous jet.
records.scope: Declared Australia-New Zealand connection from EAC separation offshore New South Wales to offshore northern North Island handoff. Excludes upstream EAC and downstream East Auckland flow.
records.source_time_convention: Historical geographic connection, not a dated observed axis. Source Figure8.23 includes September-October1979 observations; this route is not their digitization.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.identity_interpretation: Tasman Front is a segment and statistical connection, not an independently additive current system.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

records.source_locator: Schott and McCreary2001 section5.1.1, printed57-59, Figures41-44: late September onset; November southward flow along east coasts of India and Sri Lanka, contrasting spring and summer confluence.
records.scope: Declared November southward coastal envelope from offshore northern Bay of Bengal to southeast Sri Lanka monsoon-current handoff. No basin-interior gyre, offshore freshwater plume or downstream monsoon leg included.
records.source_time_convention: November southward-phase geography in a review of different years; not all months, annual extremes or one observed continuous trajectory.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

records.source_locator: Schott and McCreary2001 section5.1.2, printed59-61: equatorward March-October surface phase; northward winter phase and southern Laccadive handoff.
records.scope: Declared west-India surface coastal envelope from offshore Gujarat to offshore southwest-tip handoff near8N. Excludes coastal undercurrent, Laccadive gyre detours and Sri Lanka monsoon flow.
records.source_time_convention: Common geographic envelope for reversing summer/winter phases; direction reverses and exact occupied extent is not measured.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

records.source_locator: Chapter11 printed181/196 / PDF191/206: winter eastward SECC continuation into South Java and Indonesian seas, strongest westward surface phase in August; December2001 version. Existing Iskandar2006/Sprintall2010 regional records distinguish Java-Bali reach and Sumatra/Savu-Ombai extensions.
records.scope: Declared surface South Java/Sumatra coastal-system convention from offshore southwest Sumatra to Lombok handoff. Excludes upstream basin SECC, downstream Savu/Ombai branches and South Java Undercurrent.
records.source_time_convention: Reversing surface-system geography; nominal line is eastward winter orientation, not a year-round axis.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.identity_interpretation: Uses the broader South Java coastal-system interpretation including southwest Sumatra; narrower Java-only study reaches remain separately visible.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

records.source_locator: Schott and McCreary2001 section5.1.5, printed63-65: SMC from western Arabian Sea past south Sri Lanka turns north into Bay of Bengal; NMC reverses, June-September versus November-February.
records.scope: Declared southwest-monsoon principal corridor from offshore western Arabian Sea source handoff to Bay of Bengal turning/handoff east of Sri Lanka. Excludes Somali boundary legs, equatorial Wyrtki jets, coastal WICC/EICC lengths and uncertain farther-east branch.
records.source_time_convention: Southwest-monsoon June-September convention. Reverse NMC follows different detours; this is not its exact path or an annual maximum.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.identity_interpretation: A principal SMC phase is the display convention for the named reversing monsoon-current system; opposite-phase geometry is not summed.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

records.source_locator: Chapter14 printed249-250 / PDF259-260, version September2002: poleward summer surface current south of Cap Blanc21N, winter subsurface continuation toward Cape Bojador27N.
records.scope: Declared summer surface branch from offshore Senegal/Dakar source neighborhood to Cap Blanc handoff. Excludes winter poleward undercurrent north of21N, Canary equatorward jet and Guinea Dome loops.
records.source_time_convention: Summer surface convention; not a year-round surface route or measured seasonal range.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.identity_interpretation: Length applies to the summer surface branch. Extending to27N would change the vertical/seasonal object and is not included.
records.fixed_drawing_vertex_rationale: An offshore Dakar headland control keeps the geographic passage outside the peninsula while endpoints and the remaining route vary. Initial32 failed cases across both affected owners are retained in the diagnostic archive.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

records.source_locator: Sutherland and Pickart2008 sections3/3.5 and8-9: southeast shelf and Cape Farewell, weak assumed northern identification near68N, merging/approach to shelfbreak current near63N.
records.scope: Conditional full southeast-Greenland coastal reference envelope from weak northern68N identification to Cape Farewell handoff. Excludes EGC shelfbreak route, offshore diversions and West Greenland continuation.
records.source_time_convention: Geographic convention informed by the study sections; no continuous year-round isolated coastal axis inferred.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.identity_interpretation: Northern extension and continuity as a separate coastal jet are uncertain; this provisional route explicitly adopts the weak68N identification.
records.fixed_drawing_vertex_rationale: An offshore southeast Cape Farewell control avoids clipping the headland in the coarse display geometry. This is a geographic drawing control, not a sampled current axis.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.

records.source_locator: Introduction and Figure1: Northern Current forms from west/east Corsica feeders, follows Ligurian-Provencal slope toward Gulf of Lion and Catalan basin.
records.scope: Declared Ligurian regional segment of the Northern Current: north-Corsica feeder convergence neighborhood, offshore Ligurian arc, then eastern Provencal handoff. Excludes separate Corsica feeder lengths and downstream Gulf of Lion/Catalan continuation.
records.source_time_convention: Geographic segment convention, not the December2011 experiment track or a measured annual path.
records.gate_rationale: OSW selects rounded offshore handoffs from the cited named-flow geography. These are reference-extent conventions, not diagnosed fluid origins or terminations.
records.identity_interpretation: Catalog identity is a regional segment. This estimates the complete declared Ligurian segment, not the entire Northern Current.
records.method: WGS84 geodesic leg sums through explicit geographic reference extents. Source text/maps identify named-flow geography; OSW chooses the handoffs and connecting controls.
